SECTION: WEBSITE ADMISSION RULE: TRANSFER FROM ANOTHER LSPU CAMPUS (WITHIN THE LSPU SYSTEM)
WEBSITE ADMISSION RULE: TRANSFER FROM ANOTHER LSPU CAMPUS (WITHIN THE LSPU SYSTEM)
Source: LSPU official website admission pages, text supplied by the maintainer (September 2026); not from the Handbook or Citizen's Charter (Transfer Admission: Transfer within LSPU System).
Students from another LSPU constituent campus who have earned at least 30 collegiate academic units may be admitted as transferees, subject to the rules of the admitting college. The student must present honorable dismissal from the college or university last attended; must complete in LSPU at least 50% of the units required for the program (75% if running for honors); and the University's quota must not yet be filled.
An admitted transferee may not enroll in a subject whose prerequisite, taken elsewhere, has not been validated or repeated in LSPU. All courses for which advanced credit is sought must be validated at the time stated in the validation requirements.
The validation schedule was not supplied. The source says the transferee "must have completed" the 50% or 75% of units in LSPU; this is read as a residency requirement. Confirm with the Registrar.

SOURCE: LSPU_SOURCE.txt | CHUNK: pillar3_txt_chunk_409
SECTION: Chapter 3 | Article 2. Admission Requirements
2.2.1. Non-immigrant or foreign student-applicants who graduated from a high school abroad and have not enrolled in the university may be admitted to the freshmen class.

2.2.2. The foreign applicant must be a graduate of recognized secondary schools or colleges in their country of origin and submit complete documents. Transferees must show records or proofs of current registration or completion of term course.

2.2.3. Qualifying in the university national or international foreign administered examination such as the General Certificate of Education (GCE) Examination or the Scholastic Aptitude Test (SAT) or any equivalent examination.

2.2.3.1. GCE: 3 ordinary level passed and two advanced levels passed

2.2.3.2. Scholastic Aptitude Test: Minimum total score of 1200

2.2.3.3. IBE (International Baccalaureate Diploma)

2.2.4. The foreign student applicant who is not a native English speaker is required to have at least earned a minimum score of 500 in the Test of English as Foreign Language
